Works on corporate networks that inspect HTTPS: the backend now trusts your OS certificate store and the dashboard tells you when a certificate could not be verified instead of failing silently. Signing in survives a window reload, the Activity feed no longer pulls full message bodies every 20 seconds (the per-request compression detail view is gone), and long minified or encoded tool outputs are trimmed with a retrieval marker. Plus Windows config-write retries and Sentry noise fixes.
